stock.description: BII Railway Transportation Technology Holdings Company Limited operates as an investment holding firm, specializing in the full lifecycle of application solutions within the People's Republic of China, encompassing their design, manufacturing, deployment, sales, and ongoing support. The company's activities are organized into several key areas. Its Intelligent Railway Transportation division delivers comprehensive application solutions for the rail sector, including necessary software, hardware, and spare parts, and also provides solutions for the networking and control systems of public transport. Products from this segment include advanced passenger information systems, automated fare collection systems, dedicated clearing centers for fare collection, and traffic control centers. The Infrastructure Information segment focuses on offering civil communication transmission services, complete with associated software, hardware, and components, specifically for utility tunnel environments. Furthermore, the Business Development Investment segment is responsible for overseeing equity investments in both railway transportation and broader infrastructure projects. Established in 2011, the company is headquartered in Beijing, PRC. It adopted its current name in August 2017, having previously been known as China City Railway Transportation Technology Holdings Company Limited. BII Railway Transportation Technology Holdings Company Limited functions as a subsidiary of Beijing Infrastructure Investment (Hong Kong) Limited.
